name: Zoho Social
description: Zoho Social is a social media management platform for scheduling posts, monitoring channels, collaborating with teams, and reporting on performance. It supports product-managed connections to social networks and selected Zoho services.
agentUseSummary: Preview Zoho Social's product scope. Connect and agent actions remain unavailable because Zoho does not publish a Zoho Social customer API and authentication contract.

capabilities.label: Manage social media
capabilities.description: Preview the product capability that could be implemented only after Zoho publishes or explicitly approves a Zoho Social customer API contract.

blocked.label: Connect without a Zoho Social API contract
blocked.description: Zoho's public REST API catalog does not publish a Zoho Social API, authentication model, permissions, rate limits, or revocation contract for customer integrations.

blocked.label: Use private APIs or browser sessions
blocked.description: Passwords, cookies, sessions, traffic capture, undocumented endpoints, generic Zoho tokens, reverse engineering, scraping, and interface automation are blocked.

blocked.label: Access Zoho Social account or content data
blocked.description: Brands, channels, profiles, posts, media, messages, contacts, reports, analytics, collaborators, and identity data are unavailable without an authorized Zoho Social API contract.

blocked.label: Publish or administer Zoho Social
blocked.description: Creating, scheduling, or publishing posts; responding to messages; or changing channels, teams, integrations, subscriptions, or administration is unavailable without an authorized Zoho Social API contract.

approvalProfiles.label: Provider API contract required
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action is callable until Zoho publishes or explicitly approves a complete Zoho Social customer API and authentication contract for Relay.

runtimeSupport.description: Zoho Social is visible for discovery, but no OpenClaw tools are callable without a provider-approved API contract.
Zoho Social is visible for discovery, but no Hermes tools are callable without a provider-approved API contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Zoho's public REST API catalog does not list Zoho Social, and its Social help and integrations materials do not publish a customer API, authentication, permission, rate-limit, or revocation contract. Generic Zoho APIs and CRM connector facilities are not a Zoho Social integration contract.
providerSetup.nextAction: Wait for Zoho to publish or explicitly approve a complete Zoho Social customer API, authentication, permissions, rate-limit, revocation, privacy, and customer-authorization contract before adding credentials or runtime tools.

evidence.supports: Zoho's official REST API catalog lists product-specific APIs but does not list Zoho Social or publish a Social authentication and endpoint contract.
The official Zoho Social help center documents product workflows and managed features but does not publish a customer developer API contract.
Zoho Social documents its product-managed social channels and selected Zoho and Canva integrations without exposing a third-party customer API contract for Relay.
Zoho's terms prohibit unauthorized access, interference, reverse engineering, and providing services based on Zoho Services without prior written permission.

securityNotes: Relay does not accept Zoho Social usernames, passwords, cookies, sessions, generic Zoho OAuth tokens, social-network tokens, or any other credential.
Relay does not call undocumented Zoho Social endpoints, capture traffic, scrape the service, automate the browser, reverse engineer the application, or bypass provider controls.
Generic Zoho REST APIs for named products and connector facilities documented for Zoho CRM or vertical CRM are not repurposed as a Zoho Social API.
Product-managed channel and Zoho-service integrations do not establish a customer API, authentication, permission, rate-limit, or revocation contract for Relay.
Brands, channels, profiles, posts, media, messages, contacts, reports, analytics, collaborators, publishing, billing, and administration remain unavailable.
A future connector requires a first-party or explicitly approved Zoho Social API and authentication contract with documented permissions, rates, revocation, privacy, and customer authorization.
